MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

2. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 37
   D. 1

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. They are equal

4. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.7
   C. 15.6
   D. 21

5. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 24.5
   B. 49
   C. 8
   D. 7

6. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 31.6
   D. 37

7. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

8. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 2

9. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x = 5

10. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 88
   B. 19
   C. 22
   D. 38

12. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

13. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 25
   D. 19.7

14. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 29
   C. 23
   D. 23.7

15. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 36
   C. 77
   D. 18

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 105
   C. 22
   D. 30

18. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

19. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 46
   C. 120
   D. 23

21. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 5
   C. 4
   D. 8

22. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

23. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 31
   C. 41
   D. 43

24. Solve for x: x + 9 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 10
   D. 9

25. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

26. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 21
   C. 1
   D. 9

27. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 26
   C. 13
   D. 170

28. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

29. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

30. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

33. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

34. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

35. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

36. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

37. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

38. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

39. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

40. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
